title: Structured workout for upload to Garmin Connect
description: One structured workout (running, cycling or pool swimming) that training_analyze converts to Garmin Connect's workout format and uploads (optionally scheduling it on a calendar date). Write exactly one workout object per JSON file and save it in the app's workouts/ folder. To deliver a whole week's plan, put one such file per workout (each with its schedule_date, file names starting with the date, e.g. '2026-10-20_Tempo.json') at the root of a single .zip named after the week (e.g. 'week_2026-10-19.zip'); the app unpacks it and can upload the week in one go. Only .json files in the archive are read. Steps run in order; nest a repeat block to repeat a group of steps. Every step needs a duration (time, distance, or until the lap button is pressed) and may have one target (pace, heart rate, power or cadence). Paces are 'm:ss' strings: per kilometre for running, per 100 m for swimming. Do not include any keys that are not defined here.

name.description: Workout name as shown in Garmin Connect and on the watch, e.g. '6x600m @ 3:55'.

sport.description: Sport of the workout. 'swimming' means pool swimming and requires pool_length_m.

description.description: Optional free-text notes about the workout's purpose.

pool_length_m.description: Pool length in metres (usually 25 or 50). Required for swimming, not allowed otherwise.

schedule_date.description: Optional calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) to schedule the workout on in Garmin Connect after upload.

repeat.description: Repeat the contained steps a number of times, e.g. 6 x (600 m hard + 90 s jog).

steps.description: Steps performed in each iteration. Repeats may be nested.

type.description: Step kind: 'interval' for work efforts, 'recovery' for active recovery (jog/easy spin), 'rest' for standing/wall rest.

description.description: Optional short note shown on the watch for this step, e.g. 'Hard', 'Easy jog'.

stroke.description: Swimming only: stroke for this step. Defaults to 'free' for swimming.

equipment.description: Swimming only: equipment used in this step.

duration.description: How the step ends. Exactly one of time_s, distance_m or lap_button.

lap_button.description: Step lasts until the lap button is pressed.

pace.description: Pace as 'm:ss' — per km for running, per 100 m for swimming.

target.description: Optional intensity target for the step. 'from' is the easier end of the range and 'to' the harder end (for pace: from = slower, to = faster).

oneOf.description: Pace range, running or swimming only, e.g. {"type":"pace","from":"4:05","to":"3:55"}.

zone.description: Heart rate zone from the athlete's Garmin settings.
Power zone from the athlete's Garmin settings.
